compliance.label: Compliance notice:
compliance.body: This platform is a software decision-support tool focused on pre-payment compliance risk screening, smart comparison and routing across licensed channels, and transparent tracking of the settlement chain. It holds no payment licence, does not touch or hold funds, and provides no crypto/stablecoin exchange, custody or transfer of any kind; all settlement is performed by licensed financial institutions. The information and recommendations it generates are for reference only — the licensed institution's execution result is authoritative.

precheck.doNotSendDesc: A critical blocker was detected. Resolve it, or acknowledge the risk to continue for review.
precheck.detailsNeedVerificationDesc: This payment is flagged high-risk mainly because of issues in the payee's basic details. These should first be verified with the supplier and logged as a case — rather than acknowledging the risk and going straight to approval. The {{count}} item(s) below can be synced to the supplier in one click:
precheck.syncIssues: Sync issues to supplier for verification
precheck.syncFailed: Couldn't create the verification request. Please try again.
precheck.replyHint: Once the supplier replies, update the status in Cases. When verified, the risk clears automatically — no need to force it through by acknowledging the risk.
precheck.allChecksPassed: All checks passed — safe to route.
precheck.whyBounceDesc: Most likely return reasons on this corridor, ranked by probability.
precheck.recommendVerify: We recommend verifying the issues above with the supplier before deciding. If they truly can't be verified and the payment must go out with the risk, you can acknowledge it.
precheck.cantVerifyAck: Can't verify — acknowledge the risk anyway
precheck.acknowledgeDesc: This payee scores <0>{{score}}/100</0> with an estimated <1>{{prob}}</1> return probability. If returned, expect a loss of about <2>{{days}} days</2> and <3>{{fees}}</3> in non-refundable fees. High-risk payments can still proceed, but generate an audit trail for compliance review — you accept the compliance and loss responsibility.
precheck.gateHint: Sync the supplier-info issues above for verification, or choose “Can't verify — acknowledge the risk anyway” to continue.
precheck.structuralNote: Jurisdiction-level risk — contacting the payee can't clear it. Avoid it by choosing a compliant route in the next step.
precheck.savedToCases: Saved to Cases → Verification requests. Update the status there once the payee replies.
precheck.generateFailed: Could not generate the request. Please try again.
precheck.trackCaseHint: A verification case has been created. We recommend tracking the supplier reply there and releasing only after it clears. Acknowledging the risk is only for cases that truly can't be verified yet must go out.
precheck.stablecoinHint: This route is settled by an overseas licensed institution. The platform only compares and routes; it holds no funds and performs no crypto transfer.

route.highRiskBanner: <0>High-risk payment ({{score}}/100, ~{{prob}} return probability).</0> You acknowledged the risk and chose to continue. High-risk payments can still proceed, but generate an audit trail for compliance review — you accept the compliance and loss responsibility.
route.compareHint: Tap a channel to compare its money-flow, fees and return risk. All amounts settle in <0>USD</0>; the payee is credited in their local currency by the rail.
route.aiHint: Routing is decided by the rule engine. Let DeepSeek explain in plain language why the recommended route wins over the alternatives.

review.title: Reviewer queue
review.subtitle: Maker-checker control: every payment instruction a cashier submits waits here for a second-signature approval before it is released and turned into a payout instruction.
review.demoBody: Maker and Checker are simulated by switching identity on this one login so you can see the full control in a demo. In production, Maker and Checker are two separate user accounts — self-approval is already hard-blocked on the server.
review.mutualControl: Maker and Checker act as a mutual control: a payment submitted as the Maker must be approved from the Checker role (you can't approve your own submission). Here both roles run on the same demo login; production uses two distinct accounts.
review.emptyDesc: Payments a cashier submits for approval will appear here.
review.veryLarge: Very large payout — high-risk lane, second signature required.
review.highRiskHeld: High-risk payment — likely held at {{bank}}. Approving releases it and generates a payout instruction (submitted to the licensed institution by an operator), and records your sign-off in the audit trail.
review.highRisk: High-risk payment. Approving releases it and generates a payout instruction (submitted to the licensed institution by an operator), and records your sign-off in the audit trail.
review.softenedOne: {{title}} was verified with the supplier via a case and cleared. Risk score lowered from {{from}} to {{to}}{{levelNote}}. Review the remaining factors before approving.
review.softenedMany: {{count}} info issue(s) were verified with the supplier and cleared. Risk score lowered from {{from}} to {{to}}{{levelNote}}. Review the remaining factors before approving.
review.rejectPlaceholder: Reason for returning to the cashier (required)
review.actingMakerNote: You're currently acting as the Maker. Segregation of duties requires a different person to approve — switch to the Checker role to approve; the Maker role can only return it.
review.errSelfReview: Approval blocked: switch to the Checker role to approve. Maker and checker must be different roles.
review.errGeneric: Could not record the decision. Please try again.
review.switchToApprove: Switch to the Checker role to approve

swift.title: SWIFT / BIC validation
swift.hit: The beneficiary SWIFT/BIC code is malformed — the wire will bounce at the routing bank.
swift.remediation: Confirm the 8 or 11-character SWIFT/BIC with the beneficiary bank.

iban.title: IBAN validation
iban.hit: The IBAN fails structural validation — high chance of an invalid-account return.
iban.remediation: Re-collect the IBAN and verify the country + check digits.

company-name.title: Company name & suffix
company-name.hit: Beneficiary name has spacing/suffix issues that can trip name-screening at the beneficiary bank.
company-name.remediation: Match the name exactly to the bank record, including the legal suffix.

account-status.title: Account dormancy risk
account-status.hit: The beneficiary account is dormant/unverified — dormant accounts frequently reject inbound wires.
account-status.remediation: Ask the beneficiary to confirm the account is active before sending.

sanction.title: Sanctions & high-risk region
sanction.hit: Beneficiary is in a sanctioned/high-risk jurisdiction — likely compliance hold or return.
sanction.ok: Region hits no sanctions or high-risk list.
sanction.remediation: Route through a compliance review; keep due-diligence records on file.

bank-blacklist.title: Beneficiary bank blacklist
bank-blacklist.hit: The beneficiary bank is on the internal risk blacklist — elevated interception and return risk.
bank-blacklist.remediation: Request an alternate beneficiary bank or use a licensed PSP corridor.

currency-control.title: Currency control & interception
currency-control.hit: Destination currency ({{currency}}) is under FX control — cross-border interception probability is elevated.
currency-control.ok: Destination currency has no significant FX-control interception risk.
currency-control.remediation: Attach an invoice + business purpose; consider a licensed local PSP corridor.

amount-tier.title: Payment amount tier
amount-tier.small: Small payout (< $10k) — no amount-based risk added.
amount-tier.large: Large payout ($100k–$1M) — elevated scrutiny before approval.
amount-tier.huge: Very large payout (≥ $1M) — routed through the high-risk approval lane and requires a second-signature review.
amount-tier.remediation: Larger payouts warrant extra scrutiny — verify the invoice, business purpose and beneficiary before approval.
